title: Hoshino Ichika — Our Route Ahead〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kusanagi...!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You're here early.
Did I make you wait?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I actually just got here like five minutes ago.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I ended up coming early because we haven't practiced together in a little while. I was really excited.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That reminds me. There's something I've been wanting to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Tell me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Congratulations on your debut CD!
I bought a copy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, what did you think...?
How was our song...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really good!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: On one hand, it suited your band's style. But on the other, the music and lyrics felt refreshingly different!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The way it began with the chorus got me so excited. Plus, the lyrics and melody really struck a chord with me...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I loved how gentle and empathetic it was.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it also seemed like it was designed to cheer up or encourage the listener. Because of that, I basically kept it on loop while I practiced...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh... S-Sorry...
It's probably pretty rude of me to declare this and that. I mean, you're the ones who wrote it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's okay.
Actually, I was hoping to hear all your thoughts about it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've been wondering if we succeeded in delivering our message.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that she understood what we were trying to do...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And since Kusanagi's listened to it so many times, I think I'll take this opportunity to ask her about...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, Kusanagi, if possible, could you tell me about anything you noticed in terms of my singing...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to learn from my mistakes, so please don't be shy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anything I noticed...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Nothing really comes to mind...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, really...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Does this mean there's something that's been bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
And you ended up doing multiple takes because you weren't happy with the way you were singing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was able to give it everything I had during our final take, but I still feel like I could've done better...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... They may've edited things here and there before actually having the CDs made...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But anyway, I really liked the way you sounded, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me more about the things you think you could've done better or that didn't go as well as you'd hoped?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know if I'll actually be able to give you good advice, but we can at least try thinking what to do next time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Kusanagi!
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... First, in terms of things that didn't go so well, I couldn't stop thinking about how my voice was looping back into the headphones I was wearing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did my best to sing like I always do, but I got lost several times.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I can't help but wonder how I sounded compared to when we've been performing live...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, while listening to your CD, I got the feeling that you were trying really hard.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Trying really hard...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, it's probably normal for someone to want to put maximum effort into their debut song...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But during your shows, you always sound like you're having a lot of fun since you want the audience to really enjoy themselves.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm wondering if that's the mental gap you were having so much trouble bridging.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
You might be right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd become so obsessed with trying to sing like “normal” that I sort of stopped having fun...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. Things weren't normal because they had us play together, but I had to sing separately by myself...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for taking the time to discuss this with me, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I have a slightly better understanding of what went wrong.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? I'm glad I could help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't know when we'll be recording our next song, but I'll do my best to apply what we just talked about.
